paper.title: Signature Approach for Contextual Bandits with Nonlinear and Path-dependent Rewards

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandit with nonlinear and path-dependent rewards
unmapped: Contexts are windows X_[t-L,t] of a continuous-time stochastic process with finite p-variation (non-i.i.d., non-stationary, path-dependent)
Each arm has its own unknown continuous path functional f_a; rewards are approximated by linear functionals of truncated signature features (disjoint linear model with approximation error)
The learner knows the signature depth N and window length L and a bound on the contextual signature feature norm
settings.definition_quote: the learner selects an action $A_t \in \cF_t$ and immediately receives a reward $r_t = f_{A_t}(X_{[t-L,t]}) + \eta_t$, where, for each action $a \in [K]$, the unknown function $f_a : \pathspaceL \to \mathbb{R}$ is a continuous (not necessarily linear) path-dependent functional. ... The noise sequence $(\eta_t)_{t=1}^T$ is conditionally $1$-subgaussian

bound.regime: T sufficiently large so that T_0 <= T (used in the proof)

symbols.m_sig: signature feature dimension m = (d+1)^N after pruning
symbols.rho: lower bound on the minimum eigenvalue of the averaged conditional feature covariance (Assumption 5.1(ii))
symbols.eps_approx: total signature approximation error epsilon (uniform approximation error eps/(2T) per round)

conditions: context windows lie in a compact set K of finite p-variation paths and ||X||_inf <= H with high probability
(1/t) sum_s E[x_s x_s^T | F_{s-1}] >= rho I for all t (non-degeneracy)
S = max_a |beta_a^*| where beta_a^* achieves approximation error eps/(2T)

source.label: thm:sigUCB_regret
source.quote: Take the assumption as in Proposition~\ref{prop:universal_nonlinear} and Outstanding Assumption \ref{assum:unified}. Denote $S := \max_{a\in[K]}|\beta_a^*|$. Let $\delta \in (0,1)$. Then, with probability at least $1 - 2\delta$, the regret $R(T)$ of \texttt{DisSigUCB}$(\lambda,\gamma,N)$ in Algorithm~\ref{alg:dissigucb} satisfies $R(T) \leq C \,\frac{B}{\sqrt{\rho}}(\sqrt{d+m} + S )\sqrt{KT \log(KT/\delta)} + \vep.$ Here, Algorithm adopts the regularizer $\lambda = 1$ and the exploration coefficient $\gamma = \sqrt{(d+m)\log(K(1 + TB^2)/\delta)} + S$.

results.notes: Probability 1-2delta. B is the feature norm bound mapped to L_feat; generic constant C so notation O. Regret is against the per-round best arm under the true functionals f_a (no noise), i.e. a pseudo-regret type quantity holding w.h.p. Proof drops lower-order terms for T large enough, so the stated bound with a generic constant implicitly requires T large. Context-generating process is a general adapted stochastic process; mapped to adversarial_contexts since it is non-i.i.d.
